notes.title: Dealer’s Life Legend Launches Into Early Access!
notes.content:
It’s been a long time coming for us as a team, and now we're so excited to bring you the latest and greatest installment in the Dealer’s Life series - [b]Dealer’s Life Legend[/b]! 

Until the 22nd of January, you’ll be able to pick up Dealer’s Life Legend with a 10% launch discount so hop aboard, the title of Pecunia’s finest merchant is yours to claim 👑 You can [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]join our community in Discord[/url] to get tips, show off your biggest deals, and give us feedback for Early Access, we’d love to hear your thoughts on how we can make this the best Dealer’s Life yet! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185030/Dealers_Life_Legend/

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]The world is your oyster! [/b]- Your caravan is your shop and can be customised to your liking. Gather relics, goods and oddities from across the empire, ensuring your shop is THE place to go. 
[*] [b]Haggle your way to the top[/b] - Fine-tune your haggling skills and charisma to sway customers and make bags of money. Visit the auction house, interact with customers and stock the hottest commodities. During your growth as a merchant you’ll come across quests that will allow you to gain unique items or add boons to your skills. 
[*] [b]Dabble in the mystics[/b] - Magical, cursed and forgotten objects may fall into your hands along the way. Use them alongside magical potions to your advantage. 
[*] [b]Make friends and enemies[/b] - Use your charm to navigate the factions and choose who you will ally with. Beware! Based on how you interact with other competitors who share your quest, you’ll forge lasting connections or build strong rivalries.
[/list]
We’ve already localised the game into a whole host of languages including Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish, Thai, German, and more. If you have a desire for more languages, let us know in [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]our Discord[/url], we’d love to hear from you! If you do enjoy the game, please leave a review, it makes a big difference! 

[h2]Launch Trailer[/h2]

notes.title: Dealer’s Life Legend: Early Access Releasing in January!
notes.content:
It is with great pleasure and honour for us to announce that Dealer’s Life Legends is going to launch in Early Access on [b]Steam 15th January 2025[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185030/Dealers_Life_Legend/

You heard it right, release time is just around the corner, so we encourage you to press that “Wishlist” button if you haven't already, this way you’ll be notified at the exact moment the game will be available! We also have a shiny new trailer for you to see what you can expect from Dealer’s Life Legend.

[previewyoutube=nTNFjAeSa00;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[h3]QUESTS & COMPANIONS[/h3]
Now let’s talk about a huge new feature: quests! Many folks in town need your help to overcome tons of missions. It’s too dangerous out there by yourself and you’re too important to risk your life, so this means that you’ll need to send Companions to embark on these perilous adventures! Whether your Companions will come back with their backpack full of treasures or beaten and wounded, is up to their Skills and your choices. Choose the best Companion to send on each quest, prepare yourself with a range of potions to turn the tides in your favour and cross your fingers for the outcome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835319/08ad5184c2e3bb450f2d32a0a80b1b6cbd72b3b8.png[/img]

[h3]GAMEPLAY TUTORIAL[/h3]
We heard your feedback loud and clear and we developed a detailed in-game tutorial with a proper explanation for every game mechanic, this way you can undertake the Wandering Merchant Quest armed with knowledge and wisdom! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835319/42373066680f637935b65b1a614589e7cf8273d6.png[/img]

[h3]LOCALISATION[/h3]
Speaking of languages, we currently have 8 languages already included at the start of Early Access. If yours is still not listed on the Steam page, don’t worry, we are already planning to add more as we work towards full launch. Just send us a message on [url=https://discord.gg/DXuuj6v]Dealer’s Life discord server[/url] to show your interest in that specific language.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835319/22b49d8c1c61519e0362fa9c66fdaf66f6ae7e78.png[/img]
[h3]ADDITIONAL FEATURES[/h3]
There are a heap of new gameplay aspects that you haven’t got to experience which we are excited to share! This includes travelling from city to city with special events, the majestic Capital biome, the game ending, overall game balancing, bug fixing and lots more.

We’re far from developing everything we have in mind, and we already have lots of new features and improvements planned, but we think this is a great starting point to deliver Dealer’s Life into Early Access! We love hearing your feedback and are excited to build Dealer’s Life Legend with you all, as usual join our Discord to stay up to date!

In conclusion, thank you for all your support and for all the love you showed to our game demo. We can't wait to share this journey with you!

Stay tuned for more updates!

Your friendly indie devs,
Abyte Entertainment

[h1]Update #39[/h1]

[list][*][b]Win threshold is now checked against all your assets[/b]: this means that My Home assets value, your shop value, your item estimated value and your current investments are now included for the purpose of reaching the threshold for the final quest. The asset total can be checked in Bank - Overview

[*][b]Forger boost[/b]: the Forger can now forge items with one special feature too. Before he was able to forge only items with zero special features.

[*][b]Expert  boost[/b]: this is applied to the Expert Hidden Treasure feature too since late game more items will have a hidden treasure discovered by him as a side-effect of all the other changes.

[*][b]Item price increase[/b]: we rebalanced ALL the item prices. Average price increase is +50%.

[*][b]Item generation boost[/b]: increased both special feature and production year algorithms for much higher (+100%) late game item prices. 

[*][b]Item rarity balance[/b]: we balanced the distribution of rarities in our item database, lowering the rate at which items with the same image are generated again. This is applied to the Mythic rarity with a bonus goal: have enough items to maximize the probability of having a surprise factor (i.e.: new item) when a Mythic is generated. Changes here: more common, epic, legendary and mythic items, less uncommon and rare items.

[*][b]Balanced encounter cash prizes/taxes[/b] to reflect the new averages. It's a value per Fame Level that depends on the average price of an item per level. This raises the maximum loan per level limit too.

[*][b]Increased shop and skill cost/prices[/b] to reflect these new averages: getting to a skill to 9 is now more expensive, same to reach the last shop.

[*][b]Increased the frequency of encounters[/b] in the last District (Luxury Tower) by lowering the average number of days between them, which means moar encounters in the late game!

[*]Two core plot (PJ Cash) encounters happen now instantly when conditions are met. Before this change these happened in the next encounter cycle; after a few days. 
[/list]
The reasoning behind most of these changes is that we feel it's better to boost a lot and then cut/tweak after your feedback than change a lower % and risk that these changes are not felt/experienced.

That's all for today, let us know what you think about those balance changes in the comments. And if you like the game, [b]please consider writing a review[/b], these can help a lot in spreading the word about Dealer's Life 2! <3

notes.title: Dealer's Life 2 Now Available! 🎉
notes.content:
Welcome to all Great Dealers around the world! :dldollar:

It is a great pleasure and honor for us to announce that we just released [b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343670/Dealers_Life_2]Dealer's Life 2[/url][/u][/b]!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343670/Dealers_Life_2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/6d90a5dd0de5561fbb9ecb91527caa812a5e211f.gif[/img][/url]

If you own [b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/982270/Dealers_Life]Dealer's Life 1[/url][/u][/b] there is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18270/]a bundle available[/url] to get an additional 10% off! 🤯

We worked very hard for months, with days and nights spent to design and code all the new features and improvements! Here's a detailed list of all the new things Dealer's Life 2 contains compared to the first one:
[list]
[*] [b]All Dealer’s Life original mechanics and features [/b]
[*] [b]Overall graphics improvement[/b]: now, this is a great change
 [*][b]20 new avatars[/b]: you can choose to be whomever you want! Every avatar has its own skills set so choose wisely
[*] [b]700+ items[/b]: from yachts to candlesticks, from swords to action figures… you name it, we have it 
[*][b] Infinite customers[/b]: now with improved procedural generation, you’ll encounter countless different customers, each with their own name, characteristics and wonderful appearance
[*] [b]Pawned items[/b]: a pawned item can be paid a fraction of its price and the item’s owner could get it back after a while by settling the loan, but if the owner does not show up you’ve got a nice new item at a very low price
[*] [b]Stolen items[/b]: if you happen to get your hands on a stolen item you’d better sell it real quick if you don’t want troubles with local police
[*] [b]Fake and replica items[/b]: fake items can now be converted into replicas. A replica item is a lot less valuable than a fake item but selling it won’t affect your reputation at all. Will you pay the price to stay clean?
[*] [b]100+ new encounters[/b]: funny events, strange situations, crazy deals! It’s unlikely you’ll manage to see all of them in a single game
[*] [b]11 new special characters[/b]: from shady guys to famous collectors, every character will be a surprise!
[*] [b]Random events[/b]: anything can happen but you decide! Every event has choices to take but sometimes a specific skill or employee could really make the difference
[*] [b]Quests[/b]: many kinds of missions and challenges to face
[*] [b]Overarching story[/b]: from the suburbs to the top of the sky, the whole story!
[*] [b]Reputation based events[/b]: keep an eye on your reputation since different things could happen if you’re an honest dealer or a criminal
[*] [b]Bank[/b]: a place where you can ask for loans or invest money
[*] [b]Item Catalogue[/b]: a new section where you can unlock and collect every single item of the game and read interesting anecdotes about real items and collectors
[*] [b]Trophy Hall[/b]: a new section where you can see your most valuable deals and keep your very own collection of items
[*] [b]My Home[/b]: a new section where you can manage your own house, vehicle and landscape to create the home of your dreams
[*] [b]New employee[/b]: you can hire among 10 different types of employees, including the brand new bouncer, each one with his own unique abilities
[*] [b]Auctions improvements[/b]: auctions are now visually great, more challenging and quicker to play. Selling auction has now its own animation
[*] [b]Difficulty level[/b]: if you find the game too easy or too hard ;)
[*] [b]Improved game statistics[/b]: to get a clearer view of your current situation
[*] [b]50+ game achievements[/b]: will you be able to unlock them all?
[*] [b]Multiple saves[/b]: now you can keep up to 3 games at the same time
[*] [b]New localizations[/b]: we now support a total of 11 languages[/list]

And, for all the players that already know us, here's a recap on what is specifically included in the 1.0 update:
[list]
[*] [b]50 new encounters[/b]: bringing the total number of special encounters now to over 100!
[*] [b]3 new special characters[/b]: two great personalities and a very special VIP that will appear in the late game
[*] [b]Quests[/b]: some special characters will now propose special tasks that will bring great rewards should you succeed
[*] [b]Overarching story[/b]: from the suburbs to the top of the sky, the whole story!
[*] [b]New item selection mechanic for encounters[/b]: in some encounters you will be asked to give away an item. Now you can choose what item to give away instead of having a random item removed from your inventory
[*] [b]End game changed[/b]: with the introduction of a main plot we changed the end game accordingly
[*] [b]20 new newspaper articles[/b]: these are special articles related to famous personalities of the game
[*] [b]New item details window[/b]: visual improvements of the item details window for Item Catalogue and Trophy Hall sections
[*] [b]20+ curiosities about items and collectors[/b]: many items are now linked to specific anecdotes of real life items or collectors! You can read them in the item details window of the Item Catalogue or in the detail view of items in your inventory by selecting the “i” button
[*][b] 50+ Achievements[/b]: will you be able to unlock them all?
[*] [b]New share buttons[/b]: now you can show to everybody the craziest items and customers that you encounter!
[*] [b]4 new localizations[/b]: the game is now fully translated in French, Russian, Korean &Thai
[*] [b]Lots of minor improvements and bug fixes[/b][/list]Achievements are unlocked at the end of each in-game day. So if you've been playing before, load the save and [b]do an in-game day to unlock the achievements[/b] you are eligible for. 

We hope you are [b]as excited as we are[/b], let us know what you think in the comments! ːsteamhappyː

[*] [b]Ask for a loan[/b]: loans can give you a temporary boost on cash but they'll have to be paid back within 5 weeks with an added interest of 25%.
[*] [b]Make an investment[/b]: at the start of each new day you can take some of your money and invest it, keeping it locked for a while. When the investment period ends the money will be released and increased or decreased according to the investment result.

Every class brings different potential results: the higher the risk the higher the potential gain but also the potential loss. You  can also choose to cancel your investments any time, should you need the invested money. In this case the entire sum invested will be returned, without any loss or gain.[/list]You can have up to 5 loans or investments at the same time. [*] [b]World section unlocked:[/b] where you can track active effects and quests. Here you'll also be able to track all encountered special characters with a description.

notes.title: Dealer's Life 2 Now Available in Early Access! 🎉
notes.content:
Welcome to all Great Dealers around the world! ːdldollarː

It is a great pleasure and honor for us to announce that we just released [b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343670/Dealers_Life_2]Dealer's Life 2[/url][/u][/b] in Early Access! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343670/Dealers_Life_2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/6d90a5dd0de5561fbb9ecb91527caa812a5e211f.gif[/img][/url]

If you own [b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/982270/Dealers_Life]Dealer's Life 1[/url][/u][/b] there is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18270/]a bundle available[/url] to get an additional 10% off! 🤯

We worked very hard for months, with days and nights spent to design and code all the new features and improvements! For all the new players, here's a recap on what are Dealer's Life 2 main features:
[list]
[*][b]The most technically advanced negotiation engine you’ve ever seen[/b]
[*][b]A myriad of items[/b] to buy and sell with fake and counterfeit items to avoid (or exploit!)
[*][b]Infinite customers[/b] to haggle with, each with their own personality and appearance
[*][b]Hire employees[/b] to help you with your job: search for the best experts, restorers, profilers, analysts, clerks and many others. 
[*][b]Auctions![/b] For times when you crave a little bit of extra adrenaline... aaand SOLD!
[*][b]Lots of humour[/b] and quotes from cult movies and videogames
[/list]

And, for all the players that already know us, here's a recap on Dealer's Life 2's main features:
[list]
[*][b]Graphics![/b] The new style is so amazing that you'll want to have a wallpaper for your desktop! Spoiler Alert: there are 6 of them in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1498030/Dealers_Life_2__Support_the_Developers/]"Support the dev" DLC[/url]!
[*][b]New Encounters![/b] We started by removing all the old random events, we rewrote from scratch a lot of new encounters which means that now everything has choices! Of course even more encounters will be developed during Early Access, for example Plot encounters that will help you immerse into the world of Dealer's Life 2 and Quest encounters.
[*][b]Auctions![/b] We improved Buying and Storage auctions and we took Selling Auctions to a whole new level with the possibility of watching the Auction in real-time!
[*][b]Pawner customer![/b] Being a pawn shop, you can now accept pawned items and provide pawn loans! Will the customer pay back your loan to get his/her item back? Or will the pawn ticket expire and make you the new owner of the item?
[*][b]The Bouncer employee![/b] He's a though guy and he'll help you keep customers calm and patient. He will also help you in resolving a lot of pesky encounters.

notes.content:
[h1]Dealer’s Life 2 - Update #2[/h1]
[list]
[*]Item Pack #1: more than 100 new items for a total of ~300 items!
[*]Encounter Pack #1: With this new Encounter Pack we are going to cover all the random events (which now have choices!), with more than 40 encounters between new and existing improved encounters!
[*]Day 1 Welcome Encounter: Bob now greets you at the start of each new game.
[*]New employee: the Bouncer! Bouncers keep customers calm and respectful with their mere presence. They passively decrease customers' Impatience. Also, they can help solve a lot of pesky encounters.
[*]Selling auctions: Redesigned selling auctions, now in real-time!
[*]Improved "Price Paid" assignment on Storage Auctions: When you buy on Storage Auctions, the price you paid for the whole set is split in a better way and not simply divided by the number of items.
[*]Lose Game improvements: We are moving the Lose Game check to weekly (instead of daily). We are also adding a one week "warning" to let you recover before losing the game.
This will mitigate a lot situations where a player risks too much while having a solid inventory, we think that at least 7 days will be enough to try to recover! (or to get a loan, when we'll implement them)
[*]More game stats: better visualization for expenses/earnings

notes.title: 🔥 Dealer's Life 2! 🔥
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to all Great Dealers out there!

We have great news today. This is the huge news we always hinted all our announcements at during these last months. The kind of news that was so hard to keep secret and that we'd like to shout to the world...

Now we can finally reveal to you... [b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343670/Dealers_Life_2]Dealer's Life 2[/url][/u][/b]! ːdlgiftː

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343670/Dealers_Life_2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/6d90a5dd0de5561fbb9ecb91527caa812a5e211f.gif[/img][/url]

You know how much we worked on Dealer's Life and how much we have improved it during these wonderful four years since its first Android build, but we always knew that our game could have been even better if we had built it on more solid foundations. In order to do this we had to rebuild the whole game with [b]wonderful new graphic assets and an even better refactored code[/b].
[b]Dealer’s Life 2 graphics are insanely beautiful[/b], so full of character and humor, so much rich in details and colors and the entire interface of the game has been greatly improved and polished. Thanks to the refactored code, [b]Dealer's Life 2 gameplay is enriched with new features and improvements[/b], even more can be developed with many already planned!

Here's a proof that shows how much the graphic quality has been improved!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343670/Dealers_Life_2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/3b92678a4df8e69eeb8d0186c64e2398ef74c69c.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Everything is so much better[/b] and we are so happy that we’ve finally come to the point that all of you Great Dealers will soon be able to enjoy what we’re creating for you!
Right now, [b]all core mechanics are working smoothly[/b], [b]we have already developed some new mechanics[/b] (e.g.: random events with choices! Pawner customers!) and we are working a lot in order to take this title to the peak we’re planning to reach!
For that, we will initially release the game in Early Access and we will continue working on it during the following months improving mechanics, adding new features and a ton of new content, with our beloved community help and feedback.

Here’s a quick list of our planned improvements:
[list][*]New items, for a total of at least 800 different items that will be used to generate an infinite amount of variations. You’ll be able to browse them in a new Item Catalogue feature
[*]New customer appearances with new poses, new faces, hairs and clothes that will make each new customer a unique blend of surprise and wonder
[*]Holiday themed content: dedicated special characters and possibly quests, dedicated shops graphics, dedicated items and customer appearances
[*]New visual effects and animations
[*]New encounters and special characters, new stories, difficult decisions to make and challenging tasks to complete
[*]Improvements on the negotiation engine to reproduce each possible behaviour or trait of a real customer
[*]Game difficulty levels, in order to let everyone play Dealer’s Life 2 with the preferred amount of challenge
[*]New types of auction
[*]New ways to make money (and get loans) through the bank
[*]New unlockable characters to play with unique powerful avatars
[*]The great Trophy Hall, a new main menu section in which you can check the best items you’ve found while playing
[*]A ton of achievements and leaderboards[/list]
... And we are sure we are forgetting something here.

[b]We can’t wait to show you everything we have in mind![/b] As always we'll track everything in our [url=https://trello.com/b/nAAmRDHM/dealer-s-life-roadmap]Public Roadmap[/url], just let us prepare everything in these following days after this big announcement! ːdlgiftː
